### `caravel-sky130`

- Synthesis, **measured** (Yosys 0.33, open_pdks sky130A 1.0.471 (conda litex-hub), `python3 syn/targets/tapeout.py synth caravel-sky130 --pdk-root $PDK_ROOT`): 21,960 µm² in 3,265 cells, 458 flip-flops; 35.1% of the die.
